players.product: AI data-center leasing at Rockdale and Corsicana, Texas (Tier III build-to-suit on in-place utility power; AMD 50 MW, frontier AI lab 191 MW)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q: Q2 2026 Bitcoin Mining revenue was $113,736 thousand versus $140,889 thousand a year earlier, with segment gross profit of $24,472 thousand versus $62,714 thousand on mining cost of revenue of $89,264 thousand (power $73,499 thousand). First-half Bitcoin Mining revenue was $225,631 thousand versus $283,748 thousand, with segment gross profit of $49,605 thousand versus $130,755 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 Bitcoin Mining gross profit $24,472 thousand (vs $62,714 thousand); H1 mining revenue $225,631 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q fleet: Q2 2026 average operating hash rate was 37.2 EH/s versus 31.7 EH/s a year earlier (Rockdale 14.5, Corsicana 15.5, Kentucky 7.2); deployed hash rate at June 30, 2026 was Rockdale 17.4, Corsicana 16.6 and Kentucky 10.5 EH/s (combined 35.4 EH/s a year earlier). Combined all-in power cost was 3.6 cents per kilowatt-hour versus 3.5 (Kentucky 5.2 versus 3.2).
quarterly_data.figure: 37.2 EH/s average operating; 3.6 cents/kWh all-in power cost

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q mining economics: Riot mined 1,587 bitcoin in Q2 2026 versus 1,426 a year earlier (3,060 versus 2,956 in the first half) at a production value of $71,667 per bitcoin versus $98,800. Cost to mine one bitcoin excluding miner depreciation was $49,912 (69.6% of production value) versus $48,992 (49.6%), and including miner depreciation $90,631 (126.5%) versus $91,244 (92.4%). Power curtailment credits were $10,054 thousand versus $8,313 thousand and bitcoin miner depreciation $64,622 thousand versus $60,252 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: cost to mine $49,912 excluding / $90,631 including miner depreciation (126.5% of production value)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q: under its Bitcoin Treasury Strategy Riot sold 9,665 bitcoin for proceeds of $732,461 thousand in the first half of 2026 (versus 1,371 bitcoin for $131,802 thousand a year earlier) and held 11,380 bitcoin at June 30, 2026; it selectively sells bitcoin to fund operational needs, capital expenditures and strategic initiatives, and manages bitcoin price exposure by diversifying its revenue through data center initiatives.
quarterly_data.figure: 9,665 bitcoin sold for $732,461 thousand in H1 2026; 11,380 bitcoin held
